sources.title: Urdatorn/sphragis-alm-olmo3-greek-7b-athenaeus · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Each model is a full further-pretraining of Urdatorn/olmo3-7b-ancient-greek on one author's Sphragis training sentences only; a sentence is attributed to whichever of the seventeen models finds it least surprising. This model was trained on Athenaeus: 1,900 sentences, 221,469 scored tokens from the sentence_1 training split.
